description: This file defines a RebaselineQueue class that manages a queue of tests for rebaselining, including adding/removing tests, updating UI state, and performing asynchronous rebaseline requests.

classes.name: RebaselineQueue
classes.description: A class managing a queue of tests for rebaselining, including UI interactions and server communication.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on current queue and test states.

methods.name: addCurrentTest
methods.description: Adds the currently selected test to the rebaseline queue if it is in the correct state.

methods.name: removeCurrentTest
methods.description: Removes the currently selected test from the queue.

methods.name: _removeSelection
methods.description: Removes the selected test from the queue based on user selection.

methods.name: _removeTest
methods.description: Removes a specific test from the queue and resets its state.

methods.name: rebaseline
methods.description: Initiates rebaselining for all tests in the queue.

methods.name: _rebaselineTest
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous server request to rebaseline a specific test.
